title: Ratsasan
desc: Following his father's death, a man gives up on his dream to become a film-maker and joins the police force. He then attempts to track down a psychopathic killer who targets schoolgirls.

title: Aegan
desc: Shiva, a CBI officer, becomes a student undercover in order to hunt down Chinnappa, a terrorist. Furthermore, he must also protect Pooja, the daughter of an informer who helps the police.

title: Magic Oven
desc: A renowned chef shares and demonstrates the method to prepare various delicious recipes that can be easily made at home.

title: Masterpiece
desc: When the students of the Travancore Maharaja College start to form gangs and engage in crime and brutal fights, Edward Livingston, an English professor decides to restore order in the campus.

title: Simhakutty
desc: Neelakantham's daughter, Gangotri, falls in love with Simhadri, their servant's son. They face opposition from Neelakantham and things get complicated when he tries to kill Simhadri.

title: Nanban
desc: Two friends set out to find their friend from college, who taught them how to be more than just victims of circumstance. Along the way, they discover previously unknown truths.
